lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 한국에는 어떤 명절이 있어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, what holidays are there in Korea?
lines.beaver_roman: minsu ssi, hangugeneun eotteon myeongjeori isseoyo?
lines.en: Seollal and Chuseok are the big holidays.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do on Seollal?
lines.learner: 새해 첫날에 가족이 모여서 떡국을 먹어요.
lines.en: On the first day of the new year, family gathers and eats rice cake soup.
lines.roman: saehae cheonnare gajogi moyeoseo tteokgugeul meogeoyo.

lines.en: On Chuseok, we make songpyeon and look at the full moon.

lines.beaver_en: Is it the same for the new year? Do you look at the moon?
lines.en: No, in the new year we bow to our elders.

lines.learner: 네, 아기 첫돌에도 큰 잔치를 해요.
lines.en: Yes, we also throw a big party for a baby's first birthday.
lines.roman: ne, agi cheotdoredo keun janchireul haeyo.

lines.learner: 아기의 첫 생일이에요. 가족이 모두 축하해요.
lines.en: It's a baby's first birthday. The whole family celebrates.
lines.roman: agiui cheot saengirieyo. gajogi modu chukahaeyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 재미있네요. 명절에는 모두 즐겁게 보내요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, interesting. Does everyone have fun on holidays?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, jaemiinneyo. myeongjeoreneun modu jeulgeopge bonaeyo?
lines.learner: 보통 그래요. 슬픈 일이 있으면 조용히 보내요.
lines.en: Usually. But if something sad happens, we spend it quietly.
lines.roman: botong geuraeyo. seulpeun iri isseumyeon joyonghi bonaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, I see. Do you have pictures?
lines.learner: 네, 우선 돌 사진을 보여 줄게요.
lines.en: Yes, first I'll show you a first-birthday photo.
lines.roman: ne, useon dol sajineul boyeo julgeyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 아기가 정말 귀여워요! 다른 축제 이야기도 해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, the baby is so cute! Will you tell me about other festivals too?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, agiga jeongmal gwiyeowoyo! dareun chukje iyagido hae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 내일 축제 이야기도 해 줄게요.
lines.en: Sure, I'll tell you about festivals tomorrow too.
lines.roman: ne, naeil chukje iyagido hae julgeyo.

lines.beaver: 고마워요. 저도 송편을 만들어 보고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks. I want to try making songpyeon too.
lines.beaver_roman: gomawoyo. jeodo songpyeoneul mandeureo bogo sipeoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 이번 추석에 우리 집에 초대할게요.
lines.en: Then I'll invite you to my house this Chuseok.
lines.roman: geureom ibeon chuseoge uri jibe chodaehalgeyo.
